title: Prodo
bodyHtml:
Prodo Laboratories, Inc. (Prodo Labs)

https://prodolabs.com/

Prodo Labs is a service company that provides high-quality human and animal islets and their culture medium to support diabetes research.

Data Types

Biosamples

High-quality research-based pancreatic islets derived from humans, neonatal pigs, rats, or mice

Islet Testing Authority

Tests the quality, efficacy, and toxicity of commercial and research products on human islets. Tested products include tissue culture media, factors, reagents, pancreas processing solutions, enzymes, and reagents. Tests include dithizone staining, viability testing, islet purity, islet compactness, islet counting, islet imaging, static glucose stimulation, and diabetic nude mouse islet implantation.

Islet-Related Products

cGMP islet media for rapid recovery, long-term culture, and transport of islets

Additional Services

Contract-based research consulting, specialized services (e.g. histology analyses), and research (e.g. in vitro or in vivo islet studies)

Workflows and Standards

Experimental research protocols for human islet culture, media preparation, quantification and purification, and recovery post-shipping

Data and Resources

Explore datasets generated from external research teams using Prodo Labs donor islets through PanKbase.

More About the Resource

Prodo Laboratories, Inc. (Prodo Labs) is a biotech company that distributes high-quality pancreatic islets and develops products for islet research, with the goal of serving multi-sector diabetes research communities. Islets can be procured from human donors along with animal models such as neonatal pigs, rats, and mice. Prodo labs develops islet-related products (e.g. proprietary islet media) and offers contract-based consulting and islet research studies. International distribution partners distribute Prodo Labs islets and culture medium in Japan and Europe.

More About the Team

The Prodo Labs Executive Team is led by Managing Partner, President, and Chief Executive Officer Dr. David Scharp, Partner and Chief Financial Officer David Bondurant, and Partner and Chief Marketing Officer Brian Haight. Learn more about the Prodo Labs Executive Team here.

Publications

  • Review identifying key determinants of successful islet processing and outlining standardized procedures for yielding purified, functional human islets.
